name: B10-0449/2026 (ECR) – The 2026 undemocratic elections to the Russian State Duma and its implications on civil society
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the undemocratic elections in the Russia State Duma and their implications for civil society
part_text:
The European Parliament says the 2026 Russian State Duma elections were not real elections and it does not accept the result. It asks European Union countries to have no official contact with the new Duma and to consider its laws on occupied Ukrainian land invalid. It wants sanctions and entry bans on election officials, judges and new deputies linked to fraud or the war, and it calls for the release of people jailed for peaceful opposition.

- The European Union and its member states are asked to cut official contact with the new Duma.
- Sanctions and travel bans are requested for election officials, judges and some new deputies.
- Member states are urged to strengthen defence and treat Russian voting abroad as a security risk.
